retrieval_skill.name: layered_regime_artifact_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Separate observation artifacts, regime changes, and the latent process before forecasting so temporary sensor-induced zeros are not mistaken for genuine demand changes and a terminated operating pattern is not projected forward.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When a time series contains recurring gaps, zeros, suspensions, maintenance effects, or evidence of a structural shift near the forecast boundary.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search around the forecast boundary for authoritative evidence about measurement availability, operational schedules, maintenance start or termination, and the underlying directional trend; classify each verified claim as observation-layer, regime-layer, or latent-process evidence.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Use only evidence with clear provenance and temporal relevance to the forecast boundary; confirm that apparent anomalies are explicitly attributed to the observation mechanism, that any regime change applies during the forecast window, and that the latent trend is supported independently rather than inferred solely from artifact-affected readings.
